profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Expedia | React, TypeScript, GraphQL
profile.summary:
Tech enthusiast with a love for analytics, front-end development, and UX/UI design.  I enjoy utilizing varied tech skills to bring new digital products to life.


Skills: Typescript, Javascript, React,  HTML, CSS, Graphql, SQL, Ruby, Rails, Python, Figma

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Front End
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer II at Everly Health, I enhance and maintain user-facing features using React, Gatsby, TypeScript, GraphQL, and other technologies. My responsibilities include developing, testing, deploying, and monitoring code throughout the software development lifecycle. I collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that support our expanding partnerships and improve user experience.

Highlights include contributing to the addition of telehealth services, creating a new design system, and rebuilding the site based on this new design system.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Front End
positions.description: In my initial role at Everly Health, I focused on building and optimizing front-end applications using TypeScript, GraphQL, and React. I played a key role in transferring a huge feature from Rails to React, implementing new features, and ensuring the performance and reliability of our web applications.

positions.title: UI Design Intern (Internship)
positions.description:
Created icons for Rebellion Photonics’s newest software product, Spectra.
Designed logo concepts for Spectra.
Instilled UI design methods to organize and design how information was
presented to the user for instances such as viewing grouped events and
recognizing high priority events.
Implemented UX design strategies to the administrator’s customization panel to filter
elements such as specific cameras and gas types.

positions.title: Koru@Linkedin (Internship)
positions.description: Koru is a selective career development program that provides instruction on design thinking, market research, analytical forecasting, and customer discovery.The culmination of the program is a business challenge presentation to LinkedIn.

positions.title: ITS Support Assistant  (Work Study)
positions.description: Assisted faculty, staff, and students with technological issues through phone or ticketing system. Assistance included backing up data, reimaging computers, assisting with campus email inquires, and solving software application issues in both Windows and IOS operating systems. Contributed to solving about forty percent of all incoming issues, the highest among the Information Technology branches, since employment.

positions.title: Impact Fund Board Member, Co-President (Student Leadership)
positions.description: Researched NGOs and invested three thousand dollars each semester in microfinance institutions or similar organizations to make a global impact in different sectors such as economic development, public health, and education throughout the developing world. Managed finances and allocated funds to respective microfinance instiutions around the world.

positions.title: Paul K. and Evalyn E. Cook Richter Research Abroad Scholar (Internship)
positions.description: Conducted economic development research at a microfinance institution in Masaya, Nicaragua. Purpose was to evaluate the structure of the microfinance institution’s microcredit program and make recommendations to improve its effectiveness in alleviating poverty for the local residents. Research included analyzing data from one hundred client profiles, analyzing data from a survey responded by forty-seven clients, shadowing a loan officer, and conducting interviews with employees. Recommendations included setting up a Kiva profile, implementing an automated text message reminder for payment due dates to clients, and implementing a fingerprint system to verify identity of clients. Recommendations would impact between 900-1100 clients.

positions.title: CORE Student Assistant (Work Study)
positions.description: Assisted the CORE office at Occidental College through creating tickets for events sponsored by the department and recorded expenses made by the department on Excel.

positions.title: Intervarsity Christian Fellowship Event Coordinator (Student Leadership)
positions.description:
Planned events for community bonding among members of Intervarsity throughout the year. Events included outings, holiday specific events, and class year specific events. Average of 25 people per event.
Managed Facebook Page for Occidental's Intervarsity chapter. Posted about upcoming events and reminders to members about meetings and retreats.
